decisions.rationale: Lead Charizard and Venusaur for immediate Sun setup via Mega Charizard Y's Drought. In Sun, Venusaur's Chlorophyll grants 260 Speed, outspeeding max Speed Scarf Garchomp and Sneasler. Sun-boosted Heat Wave and Weather Ball provide massive offensive pressure. Goodra-Hisui and Garganacl in the back give complete defensive pivots: Goodra-Hisui walls Rotom-Mow with Sap Sipper, while Garganacl offers Wide Guard protection against Rock Slide, Earthquake, and Heat Wave.
decisions.notebook:
Opponent roster: Dragonite (Lum Berry, Tailwind/Rock Slide/ESpeed), Garchomp (Choice Scarf), Rotom-Mow (Life Orb), Sneasler (Focus Sash), Arcanine (Intimidate, Sitrus), Chandelure (Wide Lens).
Sun strategy: Mega Charizard Y Drought + Chlorophyll Venusaur gives 260 Speed (outspeeding 253 Scarf Garchomp). Venusaur Weather Ball becomes 100 BP Fire move in Sun with Life Orb.
Goodra-Hisui completely walls Rotom-Mow via Sap Sipper grass immunity and electric/dragon/steel resistances.
Garganacl Wide Guard neutralizes Garchomp Earthquake/Rock Slide, Dragonite Rock Slide, and Chandelure Heat Wave.

decisions.rationale: Opp core is ZardY sun + Venusaur Chlorophyll + Goodra-H + Garganacl WideGuard. Need Tailwind to outspeed sun, Fake Out to punish Zard Protect, single-target Electric for Zard, Fighting/Fire for Goodra/Garg. Avoid stacking Dragon weak Garchomp and spread moves into WideGuard. Lead Sneasler+Dragonite for Fake Out+Tailwind, back Rotom-Mow+Arcanine for TBolt, Intimidate, ESpeed cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect - Protects to stall Tailwind/sun. Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect - fast in sun, frail to ESpeed+Rock Slide. Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew - main wincon vs Dragons, resists Rock Slide, blocks Grass. Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress - WideGuard vs spread, status immune. Dragapult Jolly DragonFang / Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware FollowMe rarely brought. Plan: Tailwind > sun, Fake Out Zard, single-target Electric, Fighting/Fire for Goodra/Garg, avoid Scarf Rock Slide lock and double Dragon.

decisions.rationale: Leading double Protect with Charizard Mega Evolution safely sets up Sun via Drought while completely blocking Sneasler's Fake Out and potential Rock Slide or Tailwind pressure from Dragonite. This activates Venusaur's Chlorophyll for Turn 2 without taking any damage.

Fake Out Charizard stops Heat Wave while still letting Drought trigger, Sneasler sash tanks Venusaur hit, Dragonite Multiscale tanks, guaranteeing Tailwind vs Chlorophyll. Tailwind then outspeeds sun-boosted Venusaur next turns and enables Rock Slide pressure.

Charizard risks a KO from Dragonite's 4x Rock Slide and Sneasler's attacks, especially after using Protect last turn. Switching Charizard to Garganacl safely preserves Charizard and sets up Wide Guard protection for future turns. Venusaur easily survives any turn 2 incoming attacks (as both Sneasler STABs are resisted) and uses Earth Power into Sneasler to break its Focus Sash.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Turn 2 Charizard switched to Garganacl, Venusaur used Earth Power into Sneasler. Garganacl enables Wide Guard against Dragonite/Garchomp spread moves.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind outspeeds Chlorophyll Venusaur. Sneasler sash lets it survive Heat Wave. Gunk Shot (51-98%) + spread Rock Slide (56-105%) = 107% min combined to guarantee KO Zard-Y before it attacks, removing sun threat. Rock Slide also chips Venusaur.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Venusaur)
decisions.rationale: Garganacl uses Wide Guard (priority +3) to completely block Dragonite's Rock Slide, protecting both Garganacl and Venusaur from spread damage. Venusaur uses Sludge Bomb into Sneasler to secure the KO on its 1% HP frame, permanently removing the fast Unburden threat from the board even if it attacks before Venusaur. If Sneasler switches, Sludge Bomb provides reliable neutral/super-effective damage against incoming threats without giving Chandelure a Flash Fire boost.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Dragonite setup Tailwind turn 1. Sneasler Unburden active, Focus Sash popped at 1% HP. Garganacl Wide Guard neutralizes Dragonite Rock Slide / Garchomp spread moves.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler at 1% is fastest (Unburden+Tailwind) but dies to any hit. Protect wastes Venusaur/Garganacl targeting it while preserving Unburden speed. Dragonite ESpeed into 66% Venusaur is priority, safe vs WideGuard, does 17-39% max (~26-59% current) and with Multiscale Dragonite survives Salt Cure. Next turn Sneasler can still finish Venusaur before it moves.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect stalls Tailwind/sun. Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect fast in sun, frail to ESpeed+Rock Slide. Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew wincon vs Dragons, resists Rock Slide. Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress WideGuard vs spread, status immune. Dragapult Jolly DragonFang / Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware FollowMe rarely brought. Plan: Tailwind > sun, Fake Out Zard, single-target Electric, Fighting/Fire for Goodra/Garg, avoid Rock Slide into WideGuard, use ESpeed priority to pick low Venusaur.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur uses Protect to safely block Dragonite's Extreme Speed and any incoming attacks. Garganacl uses Salt Cure on the 1% HP Sneasler to secure the KO if it attacks or fails consecutive Protect, while also punishing any potential switch-in.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Venusaur preserved with Protect while Sneasler is targeted. Opponent Tailwind expires at end of Turn 4.

decisions.rationale: Double Venusaur to guarantee KO: Sneasler CC 21.9-51% max + Dragonite ESpeed 17.6-39.4% max = 39.5% min >33% current, so Venusaur dies even on low rolls. Preserves Dragonite Multiscale vs Garganacl Salt Cure (45-80% raw, halved by Multiscale).
decisions.notebook: Opp core: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware FollowMe. Strategy: Tailwind > sun, avoid Rock Slide into WideGuard, use ESpeed to pick low Venusaur, Fighting for Garganacl/Goodra, Fire/Electric pressure vs ZardY.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur 33% can be picked by Dragonite ESpeed (17-39% range) but not guaranteed; Arcanine adds second ESpeed and sun-boosted Flare Blitz (57-201%) to secure KO. Intimidate cuts Garganacl Salt Cure (45-80% raw) to protect Multiscale Dragonite. Rotom better vs Garg/ZardY later, but immediate need is to remove Venusaur and reduce physical pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware FollowMe. Plan: Intimidate + ESpeed to remove low Venusaur, preserve Dragonite Multiscale, save Rotom-Mow LeafStorm/Thunderbolt for Garganacl and ZardY after sun fades. Avoid Rock Slide into Wide Guard.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Venusaur)
decisions.rationale: Venusaur at 33% HP is threatened by priority Extreme Speed from Arcanine and Dragonite. Switching Venusaur to Charizard-Mega-Y preserves Venusaur for later and refreshes Sun via Drought. Garganacl uses Wide Guard to completely shield Charizard-Mega-Y from Dragonite's 4x super-effective Rock Slide upon entering.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Preserved Venusaur by switching to Charizard-Mega-Y on Turn 5 while Garganacl used Wide Guard to cover Rock Slide. Drought refreshed Sun to 5 turns.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur 33% in sun with reduced Protect. Double ESpeed risks both blocked. Protect Arcanine from Earth Power/Salt Cure while Dragonite ESpeed (17-39% max) has good chance to KO 33% Venusaur if Protect fails. Sun ends this turn, then we outspeed Venusaur next turn.

Charizard uses Protect to safely block potential double Extreme Speed or spread attacks without risking a KO at 74% HP. Garganacl uses Salt Cure into Dragonite to break Multiscale and inflict persistent residual damage, taking minimal damage from any opposing attacks thanks to its high Defense, Purifying Salt, and Leftovers recovery.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Sneasler fainted on Turn 4. Opponent has active Arcanine (used Protect Turn 5, reduced success chance) and Dragonite (Lum Berry, Multiscale). Benched: Choice Scarf Garchomp, Life Orb Rotom-Mow, Chandelure. Our team: Garganacl (100%), Charizard-Mega-Y (74%), Venusaur (33%), Goodra-Hisui (100%).

decisions.rationale: Double Extreme Speed into Charizard-Mega-Y bypasses Wide Guard and goes before Heat Wave/Scorching Sands. Combined 35-82% range vs 73% HP gives best KO chance to remove Y, preserving Dragonite Multiscale and Arcanine Sitrus for Garganacl + low Venusaur endgame. Will-O-Wisp invalid vs Fire and Purifying Salt.

Charizard is vulnerable to double Extreme Speed KO (56.2-82.4% range vs 74% current HP) or Rock Slide. Switching Charizard to Goodra-Hisui safely absorbs incoming Normal/Rock attacks with resistance. Garganacl uses Salt Cure on Arcanine; as a Fire type, Arcanine takes 25% max HP residual damage every turn alongside Dragonite's existing Salt Cure, putting both active opposing Pokémon on a rapid timer.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Sneasler fainted. Opponent active: Arcanine (Intimidate, Sitrus Berry, Jolly), Dragonite (Lum Berry, Multiscale, Jolly). Bench: 2 of Choice Scarf Garchomp (Jolly), Life Orb Rotom-Mow (Timid), Chandelure (Wide Lens, Timid). Our team: Garganacl (Purifying Salt, Leftovers), Charizard-Mega-Y (Drought), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Life Orb), Goodra-Hisui (Sap Sipper, Shuca Berry). Strategy: Apply Salt Cure pressure to both opposing slots while preserving Charizard-Mega-Y for Sun resets.

decisions.rationale: Double Extreme Speed into ZardY bypasses Wide Guard (+3) and has priority over Heat Wave/Scorching Sands. Rock Slide risks Wide Guard block. Combined ESpeed 35-82% vs 73% HP ZardY gives best KO chance if its second Protect (50%) fails. Garganacl -1 Atk Salt Cure ~26-46% vs Dragonite so Dragonite survives even without Protect plus Salt Cure tick.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll 33% HP, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress -1 Atk, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware FollowMe. Our plan: Intimidate + priority ESpeed to pick low Venusaur/ZardY, preserve Dragonite, Rotom-Mow LO LeafStorm/TBolt for Garganacl/ZardY after sun. WillOWisp useless vs Fire types and PurifyingSalt.

decisions.rationale: Dragon Pulse from Goodra-Hisui is 2x super-effective against Dragonite (no longer at Multiscale HP) and deals 57-102% damage, combined with Salt Cure end-of-turn damage. Garganacl uses Salt Cure on Arcanine for STAB 2x super-effective chip. Both of our active Steel/Dragon and Rock Pokémon heavily resist Extreme Speed spam.
decisions.notebook: Game 3: Opponent brought Sneasler (fainted), Arcanine (Intimidate, Sitrus Berry, Jolly), Dragonite (Lum Berry, Multiscale, Jolly). Remaining bench (2 of 3): Choice Scarf Garchomp (Jolly), Life Orb Rotom-Mow (Timid), Chandelure (Wide Lens, Timid). Our team: Garganacl (Purifying Salt, Leftovers), Charizard-Mega-Y (Drought), Venusaur (Chlorophyll, Life Orb), Goodra-Hisui (Sap Sipper, Shuca Berry). Plan: Maintain Salt Cure residual damage pressure and heavy Dragon Pulse STAB coverage to clean up their physical attackers while preserving Charizard-Mega-Y for endgame Sun setup.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine Flare Blitz 33-72% + Dragonite ESpeed 7-16% into 78% Goodra gives KO chance. Removing Goodra stops Dragon Pulse threat to Dragonite and lets Rotom-Mow Leaf Storm Garganacl next turn. Salt Cure ticks will drop us to ~60% so need fast KO.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect 73%, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll 33%, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt WideGuard/SaltCure/Recover/BodyPress, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware. Our: Sneasler Jolly Focus Sash Unburden FakeOut/CC/GunkShot/Protect, Dragonite Jolly Lum Multiscale Tailwind/RockSlide/ESpeed/Protect, Arcanine Jolly Sitrus Intimidate FlareBlitz/WoW/ESpeed/Protect, Rotom-Mow LO Levitate LeafStorm/TBolt/VoltSwitch/Protect. Plan: ESpeed priority to pick low Venusaur/ZardY, Rotom LeafStorm for Garganacl, preserve Dragonite.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Rotom-Mow's Life Orb Leaf Storm OHKOs Garganacl, so switching Garganacl to Charizard-Mega-Y absorbs the hit for 0.25x damage, sets Sun via Drought, and drops Rotom-Mow to -2 SpAtk. Goodra-Hisui uses Dragon Pulse on Arcanine (53% HP), which combines with Salt Cure's 25% end-of-turn damage to guarantee Arcanine faints this turn unless it uses Protect.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 status: Opponent brought Sneasler (fainted), Dragonite (fainted), Arcanine (Jolly, Intimidate, Sitrus consumed, Salt Cure active), Rotom-Mow (Timid, Life Orb). Charizard-Mega-Y sets Sun to enable Chlorophyll Venusaur and boost Fire moves while neutering Rotom-Mow via SpAtk drops from Leaf Storm.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur's Chlorophyll doubles its Speed to 260 under Sun, allowing it to move before both Arcanine and Rotom-Mow. Combined with Charizard-Mega-Y's Sun-boosted Heat Wave, Venusaur's offensive presence ensures immediate pressure to KO Rotom-Mow (-2 SpAtk) and clear Arcanine (damaged by Salt Cure).
decisions.notebook: Game 3 status: Opponent brought Sneasler (fainted), Dragonite (fainted), Arcanine (Salt Cure active, ~41% HP), Rotom-Mow (-2 SpAtk, Life Orb, ~90% HP). Weather is Sun (5 turns left). Bringing Venusaur leverages Chlorophyll Speed (260) alongside Mega Charizard Y's Sun-boosted Heat Wave to sweep the remaining foes.

decisions.rationale: Goodra 18% has no Protect and resists ESpeed (8-14.8%). Flare Blitz 36-66% guarantees KO. Rotom LO Leaf Storm 103-184% guarantees OHKO on Garganacl through Wide Guard (single-target). We outspeed both (151/141 vs 55-112). Double KO clears board vs ZardY 73% + Venusaur 33% back.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt SaltCure/WideGuard/Recover/BodyPress, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware. Strategy: prioritize ESpeed picks, LeafStorm Garganacl, preserve speed control.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur's Chlorophyll gives it 260 Speed in Sun, allowing Weather Ball to hit Rotom-Mow before it can act for a guaranteed 100% accuracy KO. Charizard's Heat Wave provides a secondary guaranteed KO on Rotom-Mow while chipping Arcanine. Arcanine's Extreme Speed cannot KO Charizard from 59% HP, ensuring we eliminate Rotom-Mow immediately and leave Arcanine isolated against Salt Cure and our remaining roster.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 status: Opponent brought Sneasler (fainted), Dragonite (fainted), Arcanine (Salt Cure active, ~41% HP), Rotom-Mow (-2 SpAtk, Life Orb, ~90% HP). Sun active. Venusaur's Chlorophyll Speed (260) and Charizard-Mega-Y's Sun Heat Wave secure the win against Rotom-Mow and Arcanine.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur outspeeds and OHKOs Arcanine with Earth Power before Flare Blitz, so only +2 Extreme Speed can act first. Rotom at -2 is OHKOed by Heat Wave and Sludge Bomb and moves after Venusaur, so it must Protect. ESpeed Venusaur is low odds (needs high roll vs 33% HP) but only line that can remove Venusaur this turn and preserve Rotom.
decisions.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect, Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect, Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt SaltCure/WideGuard/Recover/BodyPress, Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper, Dragapult Jolly DragonFang, Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware. Us: Sneasler Jolly Sash Unburden FakeOut/CC/GunkShot/Protect, Dragonite Jolly Lum Multiscale Tailwind/RockSlide/ESpeed/Protect, Arcanine Jolly Sitrus Intimidate FlareBlitz/WoW/ESpeed/Protect, Rotom-Mow Timid LO Levitate LeafStorm/TBolt/VoltSwitch/Protect. Plan: ESpeed priority picks, LeafStorm Garganacl, preserve speed control.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Mow is the opponent's final Pokémon. In Sun, Venusaur's Chlorophyll doubles its Speed to 260, outspeeding Rotom-Mow (max 151). Life Orb Fire-type Weather Ball in Sun deals 100.6-182.4% damage, guaranteeing the KO on Rotom-Mow at 90% HP. Charizard's Sun-boosted Heat Wave provides reliable backup.
decisions.notebook: Series result: Won Game 3. Rotom-Mow defeated by Sun-boosted attacks from Venusaur and Charizard-Mega-Y.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Rotom at -2 LO: Tbolt vs ZardY 30-67% (58% HP) possible KO but Heat Wave in sun 97.5-209% spread guarantees KO from 91% HP, and Venusaur Weather Ball Fire 62-140% also threatens. Tbolt vs Venusaur (3% HP) guarantees kill but then Zard Heat Wave KOs. Protect (reduced) is only way to survive this turn, waste SunnyDay turns (Weather Ball becomes Normal, Fire damage drops 1.5x) and fish for miss/protect, giving small win chance vs Garganacl later.

reflections.summary: Bringing Charizard-Mega-Y and Venusaur alongside Goodra-Hisui and Garganacl neutralized physical priority threats and successfully overwhelmed Rotom-Mow and Arcanine in the sun late-game.
reflections.adjustment: Preserve Venusaur's HP during mid-game switches to ensure it stays well above Arcanine's Extreme Speed KO range before committing to late-game cleans.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leans on double physical priority (Arcanine, Dragonite) and Rotom-Mow (Life Orb, Leaf Storm) to disrupt Sun play; Charizard-Mega-Y Drought plus Chlorophyll Venusaur consistently overpowers their core.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview of Sneasler/Dragonite/Arcanine/Rotom is 3x physical ESpeed into opponent's physical walls Garganacl PurifyingSalt + Goodra-H Shuca + BodyPress. No Mega vs Mega-Y, no sun answer, and no early Tailwind to contest Chlorophyll Venusaur. Rotom-Mow LO is only Garganacl and sun check but was kept on bench until Dragonite was dead and is resisted by ZardY/Venusaur/Goodra. Salt Cure + sun-boosted Heat Wave/Weather Ball then cleaned ESpeed chip.
reflections.adjustment: Vs ZardY+Venusaur+Garg+Goodra you cannot spam ESpeed. Must set Tailwind T1 with Dragonite, lead Rotom-Mow to Leaf Storm Garganacl before sun is up, and use Arcanine WillOWisp/Rock Slide pressure on ZardY/Venusaur instead of Flare Blitz/ESpeed into resists. If roster allows, drop Sneasler for a special attacker/sun control; if locked to these 4, preserve Rotom and speed control over priority picks.
reflections.notebook: Opp: ZardY Modest Drought HW/SolarBeam/ScorchingSands/Protect - saved for late sun sweep, pairs with Venusaur Modest LO Chlorophyll SludgeBomb/WeatherBall/EarthPower/Protect for fast Weather Ball cleanup. Garganacl Impish Leftovers PurifyingSalt SaltCure/WideGuard/Recover/BodyPress is primary physical wall and Salt Cure stall vs Arcanine/Dragonite. Goodra-H Modest Shuca SapSipper FlashCannon/DragonPulse/BodyPress/LifeDew used as Dragonite/Sneasler check. Dragapult Jolly DragonFang and Clefable Bold Sitrus Unaware not brought G3. Tendency: lead Goodra/Garg to absorb physical, Protect stall sun and Salt Cure, bring ZardY+Venusaur endgame. Us: Sneasler Jolly Sash Unburden FakeOut/CC/GunkShot/Protect, Dragonite Jolly Lum Multiscale Tailwind/RockSlide/ESpeed/Protect, Arcanine Jolly Sitrus Intimidate FlareBlitz/WoW/ESpeed/Protect, Rotom-Mow Timid LO Levitate LeafStorm/TBolt/VoltSwitch/Protect. Plan vs sun: must establish Tailwind early, keep Rotom healthy for Garganacl, use WoW and Rock Slide not ESpeed spam.
